claims: Claude Design is one of the most impressive AI design tools and is now in the Claude app
Five uses: 1 prototypes (design an app/site, port to code, launch), 2 slides, 3 custom documents/anything that fits a PDF, 4 wireframes for net-new ideas, 5 animations usable in videos or paid ads
how_to_steps: Open Claude Design and pick a template (Prototype, Slides, Document, Wireframe, Animation) or describe what you want
Export prototypes to code, slides, PDFs, wireframes, or animations
